protocol.models: Eight frozen PGC+grid 1B LSTMs; grid codes have no predictive shift to remove.
protocol.replay: Original 16-episode scripted replay; policies do not control actions.
protocol.intervention: Full 4x4 history/current factorial. Each prior history starts at zero and processes the entire preceding physical replay with native or ordinary current/goal codes. Current-step inputs then independently vary. No h/c resets or cross-network states.
protocol.retained: Identical physical trajectory, RGB, previous actions/rewards, goal snapshot identities and refresh times, ordinary code slots, and frozen weights.
protocol.selection: Every eighth selected known-goal replay sample, taking its actual next input; identical to the existing shared-replay action probe.
protocol.statistics: Eight seed means; equal episode weights within seed. Three planned prior-history TV minus immediate TV contrasts, with Holm correction separately for t and exact sign flips.
caveats: Scripted off-policy action sensitivity, not navigation performance.
Changed past inputs can affect the operating regime; history sensitivity does not by itself prove useful memory.
The external goal message is present every step after discovery.
protocol.interaction_metric: Half-L1 norm of p(past changed,current changed)-p(past changed,current native)-p(past native,current changed)+p(both native). This signed four-condition contrast is not a conventional TV distance and need not be <=1.

exploratory_state_geometry.definition: Equal episode weights; h before current input. Episode fraction is between-episode variance divided by total variance. Top10PC uses weighted centered covariance.
exploratory_state_geometry.status: Exploratory follow-up proposed after launching the shadow experiment, before viewing these covariance values. Three history-minus-native contrasts for episode fraction form a separate Holm family. After seeing those results, the existing grid activity reference was added at exactly the same rows; its two population comparisons form another exploratory Holm family.
exploratory_state_geometry.population_caveat: Shared external inputs do not mean identical RNN input vectors: trained visual encoders differ. Persistent activity differences can arise from the learned encoder and recurrent network; this does not isolate recurrent weights alone.
